resources.string: The note in the logo is the pulse of what\'s playing: it beats with the music and takes each song\'s color. The app looks new inside and out.
It builds your music in blocks and talks between songs, like on the radio. You pick its voice and how often it talks.
Turn it on in Settings › Player and audio › Transitions and DJ; it lives in its star, at the top of Home.
It measures your phone in 3 seconds, and each feature tells you if it\'s Ready, if it Will be slow or if it Won\'t run. Download and delete models there.
Tap your photo, top right, and open Studio.
Create a band with a code or a QR. Live, everyone hears the same thing at the same time, each on their own phone, and you talk with reactions.
Tap your photo, top right, and open Bands.
Tap your favorite. You can change it anytime in Appearance.
Your home screen may take a few seconds to show the new icon.
Also, the TV looks new and Settings is tidier. What each version brings is in Settings › What\'s new.
Recommended. If you turn it off, Studio and Bands won\'t show in your photo menu.
On by default. Change it anytime in Settings.
